column1: # Stand-ins for Modern Warfare III (2023) effects.
# MW3's own effects cannot be played yet (docs/JUP.md, "Effects"). Each MW3
# effect, by name and category, plays an effect of a game we already play
# properly: Black Ops III ("t7") or Modern Warfare Remastered / Horizon MW
# Every name below was checked against the effect lists of the retail zones
# (BO3: core_common, mp_common, mp_patch; MWR: common_mp, patch_common_mp,
#   pattern   override: the MW3 effect's whole path, lower case, no ".vfx"
#             rule:     words that must each start a word of the path,
#                       is assault cqb (shotguns) lmg pistol smg sniper, the
#                       slot's muzzle flash shell eject impact explosion)
#   category  muzzle_flash shell_eject impact explosion smoke fire spark
#             dust water light decal vehicle other, or * for any
#             (default rows: the category they are the default of)
#   source    t7 | h1 | -   (- = deliberately no stand-in)
#   effect    =name      the effect of that exact name; for an impact, the
#                        name of a Black Ops III ImpactFx table
#                        (its _exit table is the bullet coming out)
#             =name|view the same with the first-person effect after the |
#                        (a gun's flash and eject have a world and a view
#             ~a+b       the source's effect whose name holds all of a, b
#                        (shortest first; picked when the source's effect
#                        list is at hand); `|` as above
# Order: the first override that names the path, else the first rule whose
# words are all in the path (and whose category fits), else the category's
# default. Rules go before defaults because the keywords see what the
# category word cannot (a bullet hit on water is an impact to the
# classifier and a splash to the eye; mud_splash is dust to it).
# ---- overrides: where the keywords pick badly -------------------------------
# paths are checked against a zone)
# ---- rules: what the name says beyond its category ---------------------------
# water and wet surfaces first (bullet_hit_water is "impact" by name)
# (neither game has rain, drips, steam or mist among the effects it loads)
# a gun's muzzle flash by item group: world effect | first-person effect
# bullet impacts by item group and by name (ImpactFx tables of Black Ops III)
